remarks: Hindley Elementary School district 5 + Bed 4+ Bath updated Colonial with large E-I-K with new appliances w/ adjoining family room, formal dining room. Spacious Living room, hardwood floors. Plenty of storage and parking. 2-Car Garage & covered parking and carport. Please review floor plan. Close to Beach, minutes to downtown Stamford yet in Darien.
